summary: Inspected Test/IndPrinciples.lean in full. This is a Software Foundations-style Lean 4 educational formalization focused on induction principles. It contains numerous inductive type definitions (time, rgb, natlist, natlist', booltree, Toy, tree, mytype, foo, foo', le1, le2), their automatically generated recursors shown via #check, explicit induction principle definitions (booltree_ind_type, Toy_ind, nat_ind_tidy, nat_ind2), and many theorems with proofs using induction (mul_0_r', plus_one_r', mul_0_r'', add_assoc', add_comm', ev_ev', mul_0_r''', even_ev). The file is rich with formal mathematical declarations, statements, and proofs — exactly the content the primary index should retain.
